dataset.name: CGGA mRNAseq_325 adult primary glioblastoma cohort (2020)
dataset.description: Independent Chinese adult primary glioblastoma cohort with author-supplied bulk RNA-seq FPKM and individual overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: TRACE Explorer restricts the CGGA mRNAseq_325 sequencing batch to adults with primary tumors labelled GBM and WHO grade IV, with complete positive overall-survival follow-up. Source WHO labels are retained without retrospective 2021 molecular reclassification, and this batch remains separate from mRNAseq_693.
dataset.publication_citation: Zhao et al. Scientific Data 2017; Zhao et al. Genomics Proteomics Bioinformatics 2021; Zhang et al. Cancer Biology & Medicine 2022

metadata.library_method: Bulk tumor RNA sequencing quantified by STAR and RSEM; gene-level FPKM supplied by CGGA
metadata.endpoint_context: Overall survival from surgery to death or end of follow-up
metadata.redistribution_note: CGGA labels the RNA-seq files open access and requests citation, but its portal does not grant a specific redistribution license. TRACE Explorer therefore permits analysis while disabling matrix downloads.
metadata.overlap_control: The mRNAseq_325 and mRNAseq_693 releases share zero CGGA identifiers and zero exact full clinical fingerprints across progression type, histology, grade, sex, age, OS, censor status, IDH, 1p/19q and MGMT fields. They remain separate batches and are never pooled implicitly.
metadata.curation_note: The pinned 2020-05-06 clinical and expression archives contain the same 325 unique CGGA identifiers. Restriction to primary tumors labelled GBM and WHO grade IV, age at least 18 years, positive OS and explicit 0/1 censor status retains 84 patients: 73 deaths and 11 censored. The source contains 24,326 exactly unique gene labels; three case-insensitive duplicate-symbol pairs are excluded without aggregation, leaving 24,320 unambiguous symbols.

samples.sample_role: Primary WHO grade IV GBM surgical tumor used for bulk RNA sequencing

expression.label: CGGA log2(FPKM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: Gene labels supplied in the pinned CGGA mRNAseq_325 matrix
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Three symbols represented by case variants are ambiguous and all six affected rows are excluded rather than combined.
expression.scale_note: The pinned matrix contains complete non-negative FPKM values. TRACE Explorer excludes case-insensitive duplicate symbols and applies log2(FPKM + 1) without cross-batch normalization.

endpoints.label: Overall survival
endpoints.event_definition: Death from any cause; patients alive at the end of follow-up are censored
